subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw add a public skill configuration action contract, and should it be the proposed `configUrl`/`configButton` pair or a broader typed action shared with Skill Cards, ClawHub, and plugin setup surfaces?
rationale: The code shape is clear, but accepting skill-authored dashboard links changes a public metadata contract and URL trust boundary that automation cannot safely choose for maintainers.

options.title: Approve a typed action contract
options.body: Define a generic configuration action with explicit URL validation, trust labeling, button defaults, and docs before implementation.

options.title: Use existing link surfaces
options.body: Decline new fields for now and document `homepage`, Skill Card links, and ClawHub pages as the supported configuration entry points.

options.title: Approve the dedicated fields
options.body: Accept `configUrl` and `configButton` specifically, but require validation, docs, UI tests, and security-review proof in the implementation.

recommendation.title: Approve a typed action contract
recommendation.body: Define a generic configuration action with explicit URL validation, trust labeling, button defaults, and docs before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete appears in recent skill metadata/docs and Control UI URL-policy history, which makes him the best available routing owner for the product/security choice.
